Territorial: EU public domain under the pre-1963 publication rule, on the documented original commercial Odeon 76563 carrier chronology (1912–⁠13). US publication status is not established. Documented

Programme rule 3, conservatively rather than a US first-publication finding. The primary Symposium discography identifies the original commercial issue 76563 and matrix xxB 5731 in its 1912/3 chronology, corroborated by the Archive description. The source rights year 1913 is the upper end of that broad original-carrier chronology, not a verified exact first-release year. The 1993 compilation date is separate. The uploader’s Public Domain Mark is supplementary, not treated as an independent rights-owner release; no NC licence appears in the item metadata.
